overview.title: A classic local spring stop
overview.p1: Source Vittel is known locally as a spring outing from Ifrane — fresh air, a place to pause and a sense of the mountain environment without a full hike. Facilities are simple; the appeal is the setting rather than infrastructure.
overview.p2: Go for the atmosphere and a short walk. For longer trails, pair with the national park or cedar forest.

food.title: Eating near Source Vittel
food.p1: Picnic culture is common at the spring. Restaurants are in Ifrane town, not on site.
food.p2: Bring what you need and leave the site clean — facilities are simple.
food.li2: Carry drinking water (do not assume the spring is treated).
food.li3: Meals in town after the stop.
food.li4: Limited or no vendors on site.
